headline: Stable negative sentiment (score: -33.1)

sentiment_commentary:
• Optimism dominates today despite a negative score of -41.9, driven by 58 quotes but weighed down by a high share of mild quotes (13) limiting the score boost.
• This sits in the lower half of the 267-day range (-66.0 to 63.3), reflecting subdued sentiment rather than a true positive mood.
• Frustrations collapsed sharply from yesterday's near-peak of 86.1 to 13.1, even though 70 of 101 quotes hit strong intensity — still a significant drop worth watching.
